name: @mm/mc-harness
description: Monte Carlo worker pool, sweep specifications, deterministic seed derivation, append-only result storage, and canonical-order aggregation.
author: Ann Kelner
//: Host-side tooling, not rules-path code: it owns worker processes, a wall clock for throughput, and file output, so it sees Node's ambient types. Per contracts.md §5 it may reach the simulation only through agent-api, and adaptAgentSession is what uses that edge: a caller's executor wraps agent-api's session and hands the result to runEpisode. Zero THIRD-PARTY runtime dependencies: worker_threads and crypto are in the standard library, and a harness with no third-party code is one fewer licence to audit against AGPL-3.0-or-later.
